update.equation: At each modeled segment start phase 0 or 64, after any ordinary phase-0 update and before Predict(x_s), snapshot dynamic hidden/cell state. At Perceive(x_(s+32)), after x_(s+32) is decoded and input_history is closed but before HHist/Predict, form losses OutputRow(e)-onehot(x_(e+1)) for e=s..s+31, reconstruct each event-time effective output matrix from the frozen live base plus native pending rank-one factors, run a detached local-32 reverse recurrent pass with zero temporal adjoints outside the window, commit one donor-order recurrent Adam step and one output SGD step, restore the segment-start dynamic state, replay x_s..x_(s+31) through a state-only forward that writes no native tape, preserve the pre-replay hidden as the ordinary pending feature for x_(s+32), and then run the normal Predict(x_(s+32)).

lifecycle.activate: closure phases 32 or 96 after the closure byte is decoded and before its recurrent Predict transition
lifecycle.reset: clear detached midpoint scratch after each closure; do not reset committed F/S parameters, moments, or rebuilt dynamic state

numeric_contract.format: sealed q1 fp32 masters, moments, gradients, and output histories with compile-selected fp16 recurrent histories and forward shadows
numeric_contract.rounding: inherit the sealed q1 compiler/process profile and exact source conversion points
numeric_contract.overflow: abort before a new probability reaches the coder on non-finite or invalid state
numeric_contract.accumulation_order: absolute phase/source order for event-time output reconstruction and output SGD; local event descending, layer descending, donor gate/parameter order for recurrent backward and Adam

controls.P: qualified q1 parent with midpoint mode disabled
controls.K: detached update plus unchanged-parameter state-only replay; exact parent identity required
controls.S: same update and replay with the 32 closure targets rotated by exactly 16 positions

ceilings.reject_only_futility_rule: At a sealed scope, stop only after the treatment archive cannot meet the frozen gross-gain threshold even with zero additional emitted bytes; a partial stop receives no compression verdict.
